name: Hakuya
source:
Morito's father a thousand years ago, and the head of Ukigumo (Kamiju's faction) at the time.

Serahime, who was subjugated by the guardian, was sealed with a spell and the family was given the mission of "watching over her".

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
